beliefs.label: Earn Place
beliefs.statement: I earn my place by noticing what everyone else needs first

receipts.quote: The reference desk backed up, so I skipped lunch finding a 1978 zoning map for a stranger. My own stack waited untouched.
Eli had a flat tire, so I moved my dentist appointment and called the shop before he asked. I arrived late without mentioning it.

beliefs.label: Promise Matters
beliefs.statement: A promise matters most in the ordinary follow-through

receipts.quote: Eli promised to call the roofer Tuesday and texted me the appointment that afternoon. The leak felt less lonely.
My mother mailed the recipe card she promised, including its missing page. I put both in a sleeve.

beliefs.label: Need Little
beliefs.statement: I need a little room to sort my thoughts before I answer

receipts.quote: At dinner, Eli asked about lending his brother money again. I said I needed overnight before answering.
My director challenged an exhibit date while visitors waited. I said I would check the ledger after the tour.

beliefs.label: Work Worth
beliefs.statement: Work is worth protecting, but it cannot take every evening

receipts.quote: During digitization week, I shut my laptop at six and left the last box for morning. The numbers could wait.
The grant report was due Friday, but I declined Thursday's webinar. Eli and I ate porch soup.

beliefs.label: Trust Direct
beliefs.statement: I trust a direct request more than a carefully dropped hint

receipts.quote: Eli said he needed recycling taken out tonight. I felt relieved not to decode his face.
My sister named Saturday morning and the boxes she needed lifted. I could tell her my hours exactly.

beliefs.label: Change Course
beliefs.statement: I can change course when plans move without treating it as a disaster

receipts.quote: Our Seattle train was canceled at Union Station. I found a bus, bought coffees, and texted Eli our arrival.
Snow postponed the kitchen estimate. I lifted the tape outline and booked another date.

beliefs.label: Making Home
beliefs.statement: Making a home together means sharing the invisible work

receipts.quote: I found the utility bill under mail and paid it while Eli chopped onions. Then we set automatic payment together.
Before his sister visited, Eli washed sheets and I planned breakfast. We compared lists at the table.

beliefs.label: Right Detail
beliefs.statement: The right detail can keep a person's story from being lost

receipts.quote: A woman brought letters from her grandfather's hardware store. I asked about invoices because missing years changed the story.
I matched an unlabeled photograph to a 1964 flood report. A street sign let us describe it honestly.

shared_items.label: How I mean things
shared_items.statement: I usually say the important part plainly, though softly.

shared_items.label: What feels like care
shared_items.statement: Remembering a small practical thing lands deeply with me.

shared_items.label: How to bring something up with me
shared_items.statement: Tell me the point, then give me a minute before asking for an answer.
